title: Intraday short allocation SA03, clearing member for its trading members' clients (NSE Clearing)
when: Intraday, after each peak margin snapshot (and after market hours from 9 Nov 2026)
purpose: Each client of each trading member: minimum margin against the collateral allocated at a peak margin snapshot.
linked: Loaded as an intraday short allocation snapshot: shown on Clearing data, and each client short raises a work item for the risk manager the same day
source: NSE Clearing circular NCL/CMPT/53307 (095/2022) of 16 Aug 2022, Annexure (intraday short allocation reports, same format as the EOD report); extended by NCL/CMPT/77292 (0127/2026) of 4 Nov 2026 (additional after-market SA01/SA02/SA03, same name, location and format)
